acceptance: test_pr_arm.py, the corpus-allowlist test and test_ledger_coverage.py pass on windows-latest 3.12 or carry a Windows skip with a stated reason
No test builds a bash command string by interpolating a native Windows path
Ubuntu and macOS results are unchanged
context: Counts come from the issue (2026-10-03). Re-derive the current list from the latest legacy nightly before starting.
description: The largest single Windows cluster is tests/unit/scripts/test_pr_arm.py (31 failures): the make wrapper's arguments are quoted differently on Windows (for example '--repo must be owner/name, got "'7'"'). Other clusters: a Windows interpreter path with backslashes interpolated into a `bash -c` script becomes 'D:aBenchBoxBenchBox.venvScriptspython.exe: command not found' (test_validate_submission_corpus_allowlist.py); and test_ledger_coverage.py compares paths using '\\' where the ledger uses '/'. Use POSIX-form paths (Path.as_posix()) for anything passed to bash or compared with ledger entries, and quote arguments with shlex or an argv list rather than a shell string. Where a test exercises a POSIX-only script, mark it skipped on Windows with the reason instead of emulating bash.
